mintAuthority.summary: LUSD minting is limited to user-opened ETH Troves in immutable Liquity v1 contracts; no privileged durable mint path is resolved.

controls.label: Liquity v1 BorrowerOperations
controls.capDescription: BorrowerOperations opens and adjusts Troves; LUSD issuance is bounded by user collateralization and Liquity protocol rules.
controls.evidence: Liquity v1 resources list BorrowerOperations at this address; minting occurs through Trove borrowing rather than privileged issuer operations.

controls.label: Liquity v1 TroveManager
controls.capDescription: TroveManager enforces Trove state, liquidations, redemptions, and debt accounting for the immutable LUSD system.
controls.evidence: Liquity v1 resources list TroveManager at this address as the core Trove accounting contract.

review.evidence: Liquity documentation describes LUSD as minted through collateralized Troves and immutable protocol contracts rather than an issuer minter. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: immutable ETH-collateralized Trove issuance has no privileged mint path, so reserve reconciliation and issuer supervision are not applicable.
